scope: Suggestions only. Translation map preserves original English; root may choose these replacements with an explicit archive.

replacements.originalEnglish: in England they call a quintillion a ‘trillion’

originalExamples.en: in England they call a quintillion a ‘trillion’
originalExamples.attribution: Open English WordNet team · Princeton WordNet · oewn-13774819-n · CC BY 4.0

replacements.reason: 原句未注明旧英式长数制，与现代常用trillion=10^12可能冲突；建议不用旧数制比较。

suggestedExample.en: The database contains more than a trillion records.
suggestedExample.zh: 数据库包含超过一万亿条记录。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: he made an audit of all the plants on his property

originalExamples.en: he made an audit of all the plants on his property
originalExamples.attribution: Open English WordNet team · Princeton WordNet · oewn-00141996-n · CC BY 4.0

replacements.reason: plants 在缺乏上下文时可能指工厂或植物；本批按工厂译，建议用明确财务语境消除歧义。

suggestedExample.en: The accountant will audit the company's financial records.
suggestedExample.zh: 会计师将审计公司的财务记录。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: The river has its source in the Rocky Mountains.

originalExamples.en: The river has its source in the Rocky Mountains.

replacements.reason: Rocky Mountains 是专名；建议至少有一条直接体现rocky形容词多岩石义的例句。

suggestedExample.en: The rocky path was difficult to walk on.
suggestedExample.zh: 那条崎岖多石的小路很难走。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: Textiles and agriculture combined account for nearly 50% of Nicaragua's exports.

originalExamples.en: Textiles and agriculture combined account for nearly 50% of Nicaragua's exports.

replacements.reason: 国家出口比例缺乏年份和统计来源，具有时效性；建议不用未经核实的具体比例。

suggestedExample.en: The shop sells textiles made from cotton and wool.
suggestedExample.zh: 这家商店出售棉和羊毛制成的纺织品。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: she said her son thought Hillary was a bitch

originalExamples.en: she said her son thought Hillary was a bitch
originalExamples.attribution: Open English WordNet team · Princeton WordNet · oewn-10002403-n · CC BY 4.0

replacements.reason: 例句包含对具名女性Hillary的侮辱；可换中性动物名词语境，粗俗义留在带语体标记的释义中。

suggestedExample.en: The bitch stayed beside her puppies.
suggestedExample.zh: 那只母犬待在幼犬身旁。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: Feminine logic is not always logical.

originalExamples.en: Feminine logic is not always logical.

replacements.reason: 对女性逻辑能力作未经限定的贬低性泛化，不适合作为中性词义范例。

suggestedExample.en: The jacket has a simple, feminine design.
suggestedExample.zh: 这件夹克设计简洁，富有女性气质。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: The air we breathe consists of oxygen and nitrogen.

originalExamples.en: The air we breathe consists of oxygen and nitrogen.

replacements.reason: 英文没有mainly，容易误导空气只包含氧气和氮气；中文未擅自替原文加限定词。

suggestedExample.en: Nitrogen is one of the main gases in the air.
suggestedExample.zh: 氮气是空气的主要气体成分之一。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: de facto apartheid is still operational even in the ‘new’ African nations

originalExamples.en: de facto apartheid is still operational even in the ‘new’ African nations
originalExamples.attribution: Open English WordNet team · Princeton WordNet · oewn-00836557-s · CC BY 4.0

replacements.reason: 对未指明国家与时间的“新非洲国家”作种族隔离仍在运作的笼统陈述，建议一般功能语境。

suggestedExample.en: The new system is fully operational.
suggestedExample.zh: 新系统已全面投入使用。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: molecular weight is the sum of all the atoms in a molecule

originalExamples.en: molecular weight is the sum of all the atoms in a molecule
originalExamples.attribution: Open English WordNet team · Princeton WordNet · oewn-02911952-a · CC BY 4.0

replacements.reason: 原英文说分子量是原子本身之和，缺少按原子质量求和的限定；建议直观分子结构语境。

suggestedExample.en: The diagram shows the molecular structure of water.
suggestedExample.zh: 这幅图展示了水的分子结构。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: In the absence of sufficient proof, the police could not indict him.

originalExamples.en: In the absence of sufficient proof, the police could not indict him.

replacements.reason: police与indict的程序主体可能因司法辖区而不同，原句未指明辖区；建议用被动语态保留起诉义。

suggestedExample.en: Several officials were indicted for fraud.
suggestedExample.zh: 几名官员因欺诈被起诉。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: Refined sugar is bad for your health.

originalExamples.en: Refined sugar is bad for your health.

replacements.reason: 对精制糖作不含剂量和条件的一概健康判断，建议避免把笼统营养判断当事实例句。

suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: Agriculture continues to employ 80% of the workforce.

originalExamples.en: Agriculture continues to employ 80% of the workforce.

replacements.reason: 劳动力百分比没有地理范围和年份，不应暗示普遍事实；建议具体而不含统计断言的工作场景。

suggestedExample.en: The company is training its workforce to use new equipment.
suggestedExample.zh: 公司正在培训员工使用新设备。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.reason: 旅游业劳动力百分比没有地理范围和年份；建议具体工作场景。

suggestedExample.en: A skilled workforce helps the factory improve its products.
suggestedExample.zh: 熟练的劳动力有助于工厂改善产品。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: The cloning of human embryos is prohibited by law.

originalExamples.en: The cloning of human embryos is prohibited by law.

replacements.reason: 人类胚胎克隆法律禁令未指明司法辖区和活动范围，容易被理解为普遍法律结论。

suggestedExample.en: The researchers examined an embryo under the microscope.
suggestedExample.zh: 研究人员在显微镜下观察一个胚胎。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: The theory of the Big Bang was proposed in 1927 and expanded in 1929.

originalExamples.en: The theory of the Big Bang was proposed in 1927 and expanded in 1929.

replacements.reason: 对大爆炸理论提出与扩展的年份作高度简化陈述，未在本批核实；建议直接示范扩建义。

suggestedExample.en: The school expanded its library to make room for more books.
suggestedExample.zh: 学校扩建了图书馆，以容纳更多书籍。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: the alpha star in a constellation is the brightest or main star

originalExamples.en: the alpha star in a constellation is the brightest or main star
originalExamples.attribution: Open English WordNet team · Princeton WordNet · oewn-01279592-s · CC BY 4.0

replacements.reason: 星名alpha与亮度排名的对应关系未在本批核实，原定义语气绝对；建议基本字母义。

suggestedExample.en: Alpha is the first letter of the Greek alphabet.
suggestedExample.zh: 阿尔法是希腊字母表的第一个字母。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0

replacements.originalEnglish: In the current slump, economic growth has fallen to zero percent.

originalExamples.en: In the current slump, economic growth has fallen to zero percent.

replacements.reason: current slump与零增长没有国家、年份或出处，容易成为过时的当前经济断言。

suggestedExample.en: The shop experienced a slump in sales last winter.
suggestedExample.zh: 这家商店去年冬天销售下滑。
suggestedExample.source: 项目原创语境 v17 · CC0
